user_goal: Iteratively evaluate and debug toward best calibration energy score and distribution match; commit changes; revert regressions.
reference: ALZ_CORE_V1_f0_pg_s0, 20000 updates, unchanged reviewed GPU0 pipeline
calibration_role: One donor per stage, excluded from fitting and preprocessing. Adaptive selection scores, never independent confirmation.
evaluation_role: Keep the 20 first-fold evaluation donors outside candidate ranking and debugging metrics. Preserve fixed reference evaluation.
unchanged_preprocessing: Reuse only the first-fold optimization-fitted HVG selection, normalization, PCA and measurement classifier. No calibration refit.
primary: Mean donor energy score across four calibration donors, averaged over two fixed generation replicates; lower is better.
distribution_match: Cell-level energy distance in the same frozen 50-PC space, pooled with equal stage weights; lower is better.

accept_candidate.primary: calibration donor energy score strictly below incumbent by more than 1e-9
accept_candidate.cell_fidelity: calibration cell energy distance no greater than incumbent plus 1e-9
accept_candidate.spread: If incumbent total donor spread is inside [0.7,1.3], candidate remains inside. Otherwise candidate distance to that band cannot increase.
accept_candidate.validity: Complete fixed endpoint, finite nonnegative integer counts, correct conditioning and donor splits; no primary score substitution.

comparison: Every candidate and resampling baseline use identical frozen source donor/cell/library schedules and generation replicate seeds. No evaluation on changing draws to rescue a failure.
rollback: Commit candidate before execution. Retain results; git revert candidate implementation if worse or not accepted; never delete failed evidence.
all_time_high_scope: Best observed comparable calibration result in this experiment lineage; historical scores with different donors/transforms are not directly comparable.
good_result_target: At least 5 percent lower calibration donor energy score than matched hierarchical resampling, cell energy distance no worse than resampling, total spread [0.7,1.3]; repeat improvement on three training seeds before calling it stable.

compute.accounting: Existing canonical project accounting, inclusive assigned-card time; no reset.
